meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated.
